methodology.population: Every match returned for the 2025-season event participations of the eight FTC research teams, plus the new 2026 R.Amp team checked for prior matches. The 2025 token means the 2025–26 DECODE game, including official Premier play in June 2026.
methodology.score: Absolute difference of final alliance totalPoints including penalties, not an individual robot score. Wins, losses and ties are eligible.
methodology.eligibility: Played, scored and all assigned participants actually on the field with no no-shows or disqualifications; no modified game rules. Incomplete lineups are excluded for a representative match even if the recorded final score is close.
methodology.selection: Use the minimum absolute final score margin across all eligible played matches and preserve the closest playoff separately. Equal minimum margins prefer playoff phase, then later played date and later match number; video availability may break an exact tie later.
methodology.rivalry: One close opposing alliance is a representative matchup; this evidence does not establish a recurring named rivalry.
methodology.video: No verified individual-match video in this file; use the exact FIRST result link unless a separately verified video becomes available.

teams.selectionReason: Closest final-score match across all eligible played matches; the closest playoff is supplied separately when available.
